model: FRIO S1 Heat Trace / Freeze Protection Controller
applies_to: Ouellet FRIO (S1) smart heat trace controllers for freeze protection and temperature maintenance.
summary: The FRIO S1 switches a heat trace circuit for pipe freeze protection or temperature maintenance, controlled locally by thermostat or from the Frio Cloud. Its BACnet list is short: current, voltage, RTD and thermistor temperatures, control mode, state and sub-state, alarm and relay status, plus a force on/off command.
notes: From the French-language "Liste des points FRIO Modbus/BACnet" (pages 1-3). Object names are kept in French as printed; descriptions are translated.
The list also gives Modbus RTU registers. It does not say whether BACnet runs over IP or MS/TP.
Access is from the Lecture/Écriture column: only AO 1 is R/W.

integration.summary: Read the heater relay state, alarm summary, current and temperature. The BMS can force the heater on or off with AO 1; writing 0 returns control to the configured mode.

minimum_points.name: Forcer Marche/Arrêt
minimum_points.why: 0 = no force, 1 = force on, 2 = force off

integration.enable: Forcer Marche/Arrêt (AO 1): 1 = FORCE_ON, 2 = FORCE_OFF puts the unit in MODBUS_CONTROL state; 0 = DO_NOTHING returns to the configured control mode. This override has priority over local and cloud overrides.
gotchas: Temperature AIs read 65535 when the RTD or thermistor is not connected.
A CRITICAL_ERROR state needs a manual test/reset cycle at the unit to clear.
